notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill explains Stripe Checkout Sessions, Payment/Setup Intents, Elements, subscriptions, customer portal, webhooks, customer management, refunds and disputes, with Python and JavaScript samples and Stripe test cards.

No commands, installs or real credentials: API keys are placeholders (sk_test_..., pk_test_..., whsec_...) and the samples are code the agent writes into the user's application. Running the test flow calls Stripe's API in test mode with the user's own test key.

Review before use: the manual `verify_webhook_signature` helper (details.md:254-262) does not match Stripe's signing scheme (Stripe signs `timestamp.payload` and sends `t=...,v1=...`); prefer `stripe.Webhook.construct_event` as shown at details.md:199. `handle_dispute` passes a charge_id to `stripe.Dispute.modify`, which expects a dispute ID.
